in_marathi.name: Rajit
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे King, Ruler, Sun
in_marathi.long_meaning: Rajit हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Rajit is derived from the Sanskrit word ‘raja’, which means king or ruler. It is also associated with the Sun god, who is considered to be the ultimate ruler of the universe. The name Rajit signifies power, authority, and leadership.
